steps.title: Critic: second-model review found 2 problems in 11 items
details: The Critic objected to the understandable business rationale: it says "fuel and power products" and "municipal utilities, cooperatives, and other wholesale market participants" and "fixed-price full requirements service contracts" and "commodity marketing and trading activities", which the quoted sentences don't show.

The Critic objected to the rational capital allocation rationale: it says "identifies primary capital requirements for expanding FPL's electric system and funding NEER's investments", which the quoted sentences don't show.

steps.title: Critic sent 2 findings back for repair
details: Understandable business: rationale rewrite (the verdict stands, the rationale is rewritten from the quotes).
Rational capital allocation: rationale rewrite (the verdict stands, the rationale is rewritten from the quotes).

steps.title: Rationale rewrite for understandable business: 339 tokens in, 52 out, ~$0.0002 at paid rates
details: The model saw only the question, the verdict and the quoted sentences, and rewrote the rationale to say no more than they show.

New rationale: The company sells energy, capacity, credits, and ancillary services from its generation and battery storage facilities. It generates revenue primarily by selling these products to customers in wholesale electricity markets through long-term power purchase agreements.

steps.title: Rationale rewrite for rational capital allocation: 358 tokens in, 44 out, ~$0.0002 at paid rates
details: The model saw only the question, the verdict and the quoted sentences, and rewrote the rationale to say no more than they show.

New rationale: The filing discloses the payment of dividends on common stock and states that capital allocation is managed to maintain a long-term capital structure that supports a strong investment grade credit rating.
